text:
Maya Patel: hi team 👋 I'm a new SWE on infra — quick q on who owns what for first-week setup: VPN, GCP project access, service accounts, and oncall escalation?
Sam Li: welcome Maya :tada: short version: eng-infra = infra tooling & provisioning, eng-sre = runtime reliability + oncall, eng-platform = deployments + CI/CD.
Maya Patel: thanks. who should I ping for help with the VPN + internal DNS?
Alina Gomez: ping @Sam Li for VPN, but for DNS records we usually go through eng-infra ticketing flow (infra-requests). If it's urgent DM me.
Sam Li: adding doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/org/ownership (internal) — has owner matrix and escalation tree.
Maya Patel: I can't open that link yet (403). is that because of permissions?
eng-infra-bot: Your access request submitted. Request ID: REQ-3491. To approve faster, add your manager to the request.
Jorge Rivera: Maya, I'll approve VPN once you add your manager to REQ-3491. Also include your workstation hostname.
Maya Patel: added manager and hostname. thanks Jorge.
Priya Shah: For GCP project access: file a "project-access" ticket and tag the repo owner. If you need compute instance permissions, include the instance path and reason.
Maya Patel: who are the repo owners for model-serving? trying to get deploy perms.
Sam Li: model-serving ownership: eng-platform (primary), eng-runtime (secondary). For deploy perms, submit a PR to the infra-perms repo and tag @eng-platform.
Alina Gomez: escalation paths in a pinch: 1) ping on Slack channel (eng-sre or eng-platform) 2) if no response in 15m, ping oncall 3) call the oncall phone (listed in the doc) 4) page pagerduty if it's severity-1.
Maya Patel: useful — is there a single Slack channel for cross-team ops questions?
Priya Shah: yes #eng-ops is the cross-team ops channel. For new-hire questions use #new-hires or DM your buddy.
Maya Patel: got it. last one: who owns CI flake investigations when a PR keeps failing?
Jorge Rivera: triage usually starts with the PR author + eng-platform. If it's infra flakiness, eng-sre picks up. If you want, I can show the flow tomorrow in onboarding sync.
Maya Patel: that would be great, thanks Jorge :pray: any other tips for week1 org navigation?
Alina Gomez: introduce yourself in #new-hires with your repo list, and post any blocked tickets with the tag `help-needed`. People watch that tag.
Sam Li: +1 and add yourself to the oncall rotation doc (read-only until manager confirms). Also save the emergency contact numbers.
Maya Patel: perfect — will do. thanks everyone!
Sam Li: welcome aboard again. ping me if anything else blocks you. :rocket:
eng-infra-bot: Reminder: REQ-3491 approved by Jorge Rivera. VPN credentials sent to your work email.
